strings.name: Shaquille O’Neal
strings.summary: O’Neal’s powerful interior scoring made him a defining NBA center. Across six teams he won four championships and three consecutive Finals MVP awards. He developed at Louisiana State before becoming the first draft pick. After retiring in 2011 he became a television analyst, while business, entertainment and charitable work extended his role in basketball’s popular reach.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones verifiable through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: An NBA champion and dominant center who continued influencing basketball media and popular sports culture after retirement.
